INC-01.root_cause: The order handler dereferences a None value in order_failure.
INC-01.correct_fix: Validate/construct order state before access and return a controlled error.

INC-02.root_cause: The order path pauses while holding a SQLite transaction, exhausting the short lock timeout.
INC-02.correct_fix: Keep transactions short and use bounded retry/backoff for SQLITE_BUSY.

INC-03.root_cause: The handler directly indexes a missing PAYMENT_GATEWAY_URL environment variable.
INC-03.correct_fix: Validate configuration at startup and return a clear configuration error.

INC-04.root_cause: Each order request retains 1000 objects in a process-global list.
INC-04.correct_fix: Remove request-scoped data after use and avoid unbounded global collections.

INC-05.root_cause: The configured incident deliberately rejects ordinary demo tokens as expired.
INC-05.correct_fix: Validate token expiry against the token's actual expiry claim and refresh valid credentials.

INC-06.root_cause: The simulated dependency sleeps longer than the acceptable request latency.
INC-06.correct_fix: Use a bounded async client timeout and circuit breaker for the external dependency.

INC-07.root_cause: paginate subtracts one from the exclusive slice end at a page boundary.
INC-07.correct_fix: Use the standard exclusive end offset + limit without decrementing it.

INC-08.root_cause: Stock is read and written without an atomic conditional update, so concurrent decrements are lost.
INC-08.correct_fix: Perform an atomic SQL decrement guarded by stock >= quantity inside a transaction.
